description: This file contains functions and constants for managing network namespace IDs in Linux using netlink sockets, including getting and setting namespace IDs by process ID or file descriptor.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: A struct representing a handle for netlink requests, used to perform network namespace ID operations.

methods.name: GetNetNsIdByPid
methods.description: Retrieves the network namespace ID for a given process/thread ID.

methods.name: GetNetNsIdByFd
methods.description: Retrieves the network namespace ID for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: SetNetNsIdByPid
methods.description: Sets the network namespace ID for a given process/thread ID.

methods.name: SetNetNsIdByFd
methods.description: Sets the network namespace ID for a given file descriptor.

methods.name: getNetNsId
methods.description: Internal method to request the netnsid for a given type and value.

methods.name: setNetNsId
methods.description: Internal method to set the netnsid for a given type, value, and new namespace ID.
